Jules (docs): Starting a small PR to replace the legacy curl examples in troubleshooting with streaming SDK snippets and an explicit 'trim + fallback' pattern for 429s and timeouts. Draft branch: https://go/repo/drafts/trim-fallback :wave
Sam (eng-runtime): +1. Please call out that Hosted can autoscale faster than Dedicated; show a note that trimming history + model fallback often beats waiting for Dedicated pool warm-up.
Rita (sdk): I'll add short Python + Node streaming snippets and a helper trim_history(messages, max_tokens). Will also include a compact-model fallback sample. Example fallback sketch: ```
try:
  for chunk in client.chat.stream(...):
    print(chunk.delta, end='')
except RateLimitError:
  trimmed = trim_history(msgs, 800)
  resp = client.chat.create(model='redwood-compact-1', messages=trimmed)
  print('\n[FALLBACK]', resp.output)
```
Alex (support): I have an anonymized customer trace showing naive retry spikes. I'll paste a sanitized sequence into the PR and a short before/after graph to demonstrate jitter+trim effect.
